verdict.rationale: Blink ships a local `grep` command, which gives basic regular-expression text search over files. Its VS Code integration (Codespaces, GitPod, or your own server) implies an editor environment, but the evidence never describes code search in it. Missing for 10: fuzzy matching, search filters, code-navigation features (e.g. jump-to-file or symbol), documented search within the VS Code integration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
